title: Systemic Risk in Financial Networks Revisited: Debt Dilution as a Backdoor Bail-in
abstract: arXiv:2608.13979v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a model of interbank networks with random liquidity shocks. Networks of dilutable debt---e.g., long-term, unsecured---facilitate efficient liquidity transfers: Shocked banks pledge interbank claims as collateral for new senior debt, diluting existing debt. Unlike with non-dilutable debt, indebtedness and connectedness are sources of stability, not fragility. Dilution is thus a ``backdoor bail-in'' that reallocates losses absent a resolution authority, trigger security, or ex post renegotiation. We uncover a class of networks, ``exponential networks,'' that implement optimal contingent transfers via plain debt. Yet exponential networks are not pairwise stable, whereas some core--periphery networks are, rationalizing observed interbank structures and their under-insurance against crises.

translated_title: 金融网络中的系统性风险再探讨：债务稀释作为后门内部纾困
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个具有随机流动性冲击的银行间网络模型。可稀释债务网络——例如，长期、无担保债务——促进了有效的流动性转移：受冲击的银行将银行间债权作为新优先债务的抵押品，从而稀释了现有债务。与不可稀释债务不同，负债和连通性是稳定性的来源，而非脆弱性。因此，债务稀释是一种“后门内部纾困”，在没有处置机构、触发安全或事后重新谈判的情况下重新分配损失。我们揭示了一类网络，即“指数网络”，它通过普通债务实现了最优或有转移。然而，指数网络并非成对稳定，而某些核心-边缘网络则是稳定的，这合理化了对观察到的银行间结构及其对危机的不足保险。
tldr: 本文提出债务稀释机制作为金融网络中的“后门内部纾困”，表明可稀释债务能使负债和连通性成为稳定性来源，并揭示指数网络与核心-边缘网络的稳定性差异，解释了现实银行间结构的危机保险不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes debt dilution as a "backdoor bail-in" in financial networks, showing that dilutable debt turns indebtedness and connectivity into stability sources, and reveals exponential vs. core-periphery network stability differences, explaining under-insurance against crises in observed interbank structures.
